name: two-builds
description: Two narrow file changes, each independently verified.

phases.prompt: CREATE file out-1.txt containing First phase. Change no other files.
phases.expectedOutput: Saved first file and plain result.

phases.prompt: Read out-1.txt and verify its first-phase content. Do not edit files.
CREATE file out-2.txt containing Second phase. Preserve out-1.txt. Change no other files.
phases.expectedOutput: Saved second file and plain result.

phases.prompt: Read out-1.txt and out-2.txt and verify both phase contents. Do not edit files.

evidenceModel: Actual saved files and independent phase results.
failureBehavior: Stop and report the precise failure.
userFacingExplanation: Build one, verify one, build two, verify two.
